components_structure.18plus_age_gate: Modal dialog requiring confirmation of 18+ age before initial site interaction + permanent Gamble Responsibly footer bar
components_structure.navigation_bar: Sticky top bar with PuntRank Aus logo, live status indicator, Guest/User profile button, Pro Upgrade CTA button
components_structure.mobile_bottom_bar: Fixed bottom bar for mobile screens (Meetings, Ace's Picks, Plunges, Results, Bet Slip)
components_structure.today_meetings_view: Filterable track selector (NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA), track condition badges (Good 4, Soft 5, Heavy 8), race times countdown
components_structure.race_card_runner: Collapsible runner row displaying barrier, silk icon, saddle cloth number, horse name, jockey, weight, win/place probability bar, confidence badge, market movement arrow, and expansion panel with plain-English reasoning
components_structure.aces_selections: Dedicated tab for Ace's 60-year system selections (Winners, Places, Quaddies) with strike-rate badges and ROI indicators
components_structure.exotics_calculator: Interactive exotic combination builder (Exacta, Quinella, Trifecta, First Four, Quaddie) with calculated box/standout combinations
components_structure.market_movers: Plunge feed showing significant odds movements (e.g. $8.50 -> $4.20) with track bias and speed map alerts
components_structure.bet_slip_drawer: Slide-over drawer for simulated unit calculation, strategy notes, and pinned runner compilation
components_structure.results_strike_rate: Historical performance tab with strike-rate percentages, daily profit/loss units, and interactive Recharts graphs
components_structure.pdf_reports: Form guide & tips report center with printable summary view and PDF download triggers
components_structure.pro_subscription_paywall: Stripe pricing modal with A$9.99/mo, A$49.99/yr, A$99.00 lifetime tiers, feature list comparison, and mock checkout flow
components_structure.admin_panel: Secure admin tab to update race odds, add Ace's tips, publish plunge alerts, grade race results, and view subscriber stats

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow mobile-first design: components must look native on mobile viewports (375px-430px) and seamlessly expand to desktop grids.
Include data-testid on every interactive element (buttons, tabs, runner rows, inputs, modal close triggers) following kebab-case, e.g. data-testid='age-gate-confirm-btn'.
Ensure dark theme by default using dark charcoal background (#0A0D0E) with turf emerald green (#10B981) and gold (#F59E0B) accents.
Use pure JS / JSX React files (do not use TypeScript syntax in .js/.jsx files).
Ensure the 18+ Age Gate modal is shown on first visit and stored in localStorage.
Integrate Sonner for toast feedback (e.g., pinning runners, updating bet slip, copying exotics).

Ensure all mock data reflects realistic Australian racing tracks (Flemington, Randwick, Caulfield, Doomben, Rosehill, Morphettville) with realistic runner names, jockeys (J. McDonald, C. Williams, J. Kah), barrier positions, and odds movements.
Provide seamless guest access with a banner prompting guest users to create an account or upgrade to Pro for unlocked A-Grade bets.
Provide a working mock Stripe subscription modal with plan selection (A$9.99/mo, A$49.99/yr, A$99.00 lifetime).
